notes: Caller for the IkaKuuk macro from YleisMakrot.sas, which counts the months a person spends inside an age interval during the reference year using SELECT/WHEN and a chained comparison. Macro definition reproduced verbatim (DES transliterated). A DATA step calls it for the 18-64 and 0-17 age bands over four example persons; PROC PRINT shows results. Macro logic unchanged.
